notes.title: No Alibi 0.14.0 has been released!
notes.content:
1.14 Changelog:

New Heists:
-Collector's Home: An introductory stealth heist. You must disable the alarm to access the jewel collection. It will shut you out if you alert the police.
-Warehouse: Take on Zeke the Tweak and his goons. Come armed to the teeth if you want to make it out of this shootout alive.
-Casino: Take the casino by storm by raiding its 4 vaults. (Will have a separate OST in a future update)
-Museum: The security here is way too tight to go in guns-blazing. Disable the alarm to make it into the back room.

New Guns:
-Zeke's LMG

New Equipment:
-RC Explosive

New Features/Updates:
-A mysterious hoodlum has been spotted hanging around your criminal hideout after you complete your first quota. Find out what he knows.
-Players now start with 7hp in solo play and 6hp in duos play. Parties of 3 or 4 still have 5hp each.
-In 2+ star heists, unique cops have a chance to spawn, wielding RPGs and shotguns.
-Offscreen players now have an indicator pointing in their direction.
-Holding tab now highlights objects that can be interacted with.
-Picking up an item now flashes the hotbar slots it takes up.
-Three-star heists (Warehouse, Casino, and Museum) are now available starting on the second quota.
-Heavy drill speed has been increased.

Bug Fixes:
-Picking up items through walls
-American Carbine showed German Rifle sprite
-Game window starting in the middle of the screen
-Save data loss
-Many others

notes.title: No Alibi 0.12 is here!
notes.content:
Make sure you join the Discord to stay updated! https://discord.gg/QNvz5Jz9FG

The No Alibi Demo has received a free update!

1.12 Changelog:

New Heist:
-Factory: No Alibi's first stealth-focused heist. Drill into the armored truck picking up a large amount of cash. The entire factory is restricted, so you need to be careful not to be seen. Use the USB drive on the terminal in the back room to disable the cameras.

New Guns:
-American Carbine (with under-barrel shotgun attachment)
-American Shotgun
-German Rifle (with under-barrel grenade launcher attachment)
-Grenade Launcher
-Minigun
-Russian Rifle

New Equipment:
-Machete
-Riot Shield
-Sentry Gun
-Sentry Rockets

New Features:
-Overhauled the tutorial
-Symbol appears above character when in a restricted area
-Visual popups when collecting cash, healing, reloading, or performing other actions (toggleable in the settings menu)
-Change button prompt sprites depending on your preferred controller

Bug Fixes:
-Ammo case crashes game
-Many others
